1: // Orbit Defender game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: // The player rotates a shield around a planet to block incoming asteroids.
4: 
5: (() => {
6:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
7:   if (!canvas) {
8:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
9:     return;
10:   }
11:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
12:   const width = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth);
13:   const height = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight);
14: 
15:   const planet = {
16:     x: width / 2,
17:     y: height / 2,
18:     radius: 30,
19:     health: 3,
20:   };
21: 
22:   const shield = {
23:     radius: 60,
24:     angle: 0, // radians, 0 points to the right
25:     width: (Math.PI / 6), // 30° arc
26:     speed: 0.04, // rotation per frame when key held
27:   };
28: 
29:   const asteroids = [];
30:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
31:   const asteroidSpeed = 1.5;
32:   let lastSpawn = 0;
33:   let gameOver = false;
34: 
35:   // Input handling
36:   const keys = { ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false };
37:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
38:     if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = true;
39:   });
40:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
41:     if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = false;
42:   });
43: 
44:   function spawnAsteroid() {
45:     // Choose a random edge
46:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
47:     let x, y;
48:     switch (edge) {
49:       case 0: // top
50:         x = Math.random() * width;
51:         y = -10;
52:         break;
53:       case 1: // right
54:         x = width + 10;
55:         y = Math.random() * height;
56:         break;
57:       case 2: // bottom
58:         x = Math.random() * width;
59:         y = height + 10;
60:         break;
61:       case 3: // left
62:         x = -10;
63:         y = Math.random() * height;
64:         break;
65:     }
66:     // Vector toward planet center
67:     const dx = planet.x - x;
68:     const dy = planet.y - y;
69:     const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
70:     const vx = (dx / len) * asteroidSpeed;
71:     const vy = (dy / len) * asteroidSpeed;
72:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, radius: 8 });
73:   }
74: 
75:   function normalizeAngle(a) {
76:     // Keep angle between -π and π
77:     while (a <= -Math.PI) a += 2 * Math.PI;
78:     while (a > Math.PI) a -= 2 * Math.PI;
79:     return a;
80:   }
81: 
82:   function angleBetween(dx, dy) {
83:     return normalizeAngle(Math.atan2(dy, dx));
84:   }
85: 
86:   function update(dt) {
87:     if (gameOver) return;
88:     // Rotate shield based on input
89:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) shield.angle -= shield.speed;
90:     if (keys.ArrowRight) shield.angle += shield.speed;
91:     shield.angle = normalizeAngle(shield.angle);
92: 
93:     // Spawn asteroids
94:     const now = performance.now();
95:     if (now - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
96:       spawnAsteroid();
97:       lastSpawn = now;
98:     }
99: 
100:     // Update asteroids
101:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
102:       const a = asteroids[i];
103:       a.x += a.vx;
104:       a.y += a.vy;
105: 
106:       // Check collision with shield (angular overlap)
107:       const dx = a.x - planet.x;
108:       const dy = a.y - planet.y;
109:       const ang = angleBetween(dx, dy);
110:       const diff = Math.abs(normalizeAngle(ang - shield.angle));
111:       if (diff < shield.width / 2) {
112:         // Blocked
113:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
114:         continue;
115:       }
116: 
117:       // Check collision with planet
118:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
119:       if (dist <= planet.radius) {
120:         planet.health--;
121:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
122:         if (planet.health <= 0) {
123:           gameOver = true;
124:         }
125:       }
126:     }
127:   }
128: 
129:   function draw() {
130:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
131: 
132:     // Draw planet
133:     ctx.fillStyle = '#4a90e2';
134:     ctx.beginPath();
135:     ctx.arc(planet.x, planet.y, planet.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
136:     ctx.fill();
137: 
138:     // Draw shield
139:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffcc00';
140:     ctx.lineWidth = 6;
141:     ctx.beginPath();
142:     ctx.arc(
143:       planet.x,
144:       planet.y,
145:       shield.radius,
146:       shield.angle - shield.width / 2,
147:       shield.angle + shield.width / 2
148:     );
149:     ctx.stroke();
150: 
151:     // Draw asteroids
152:     ctx.fillStyle = '#999';
153:     for (const a of asteroids) {
154:       ctx.beginPath();
155:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
156:       ctx.fill();
157:     }
158: 
159:     // Draw health
160:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
161:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
162:     ctx.fillText('Health: ' + planet.health, 10, 20);
163: 
164:     if (gameOver) {
165:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
166:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
167:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
168:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
169:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
170:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
171:     }
172:   }
173: 
174:   let lastTime = 0;
175:   function loop(timestamp) {
176:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
177:     lastTime = timestamp;
178:     update(dt);
179:     draw();
180:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
181:   }
182:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
183: })();

(End of file - total 183 lines)
